result.title: MUNDO: a multiresolution generative framework for temporal downscaling
result.summary: Dynamical systems are often observed at coarse temporal resolution through sparse states or temporal aggregates, leaving the underlying fine-scale trajectories unresolved. Recovering these trajectories requires probabilistic models that capture the unresolved variability while remaining consistent with the observations. We present MUNDO (Multiresolution UNified DOwnscaling), a generative framework for temporal downscaling under general linear observation operators. MUNDO introduces a null-space parameterization that enforces exact observation consistency in a single network evaluation, unifying temporal interpolation and disaggregation. To capture complex multiscale dynamics, we leverage reverse Markov learning to factorize the observation operator into a hierarchy of successive coarsenings. Each level models only the degrees of freedom lost between adjacent resolutions. We evaluate MUNDO on two-scale Lorenz-96, four two-dimensional physical systems, and multivariate ERA5 reanalysis over Europe, for both temporal interpolation and disaggregation. Across datasets and tasks, MUNDO generally outperforms flow-based baselines. Single-step MUNDO achieves strong predictive skill, while recursive MUNDO generally improves temporal realism and ensemble calibration, with better spread-skill agreement and predictive coverage.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MUNDO 生成框架，用零空间参数化在单次前向中保证与观测精确一致的时序降尺度，并借反向马尔可夫学习将观测算子分解为逐级粗化层级，每层只建模相邻分辨率间丢失的自由度，统一时间插值与解聚。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「强制与观测一致」加「按分辨率层级显式建模丢失自由度」的状态分解思路，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据如何留在 latent、以及多尺度信息坍缩的刻画提供概念参照，可供核查是否可迁移。
